'''Grimstone''' is an island north of [[Weiss]]. It is a long-forgotten frozen island beyond the [[Fremennik]]s' border, requiring 87 [[Sailing]] to moor on. As Grimstone is in [[icy seas]], an [[eternal brazier]] is required to access it.

The island surface contains several rocks of coal, nickel, adamantite, and runite, along with a [[wallasalki]] colony that resides on the southern half of the island. There is also a [[lockbox]] which contains the [[dragon keel schematic]]. Additionally, there is a cave leading to the [[Grimstone Dungeon]], which is the main attraction of the island. The dungeon contains [[Chilled jelly|chilled jellies]], [[frost dragon]]s, as well as a [[Ancient Furnace|furnace]] that can smelt cannonballs at twice the normal speed. 

==Transportation==
* Teleport to [[fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|DLP}} inside the dungeon (requires that you have moored on the island at least once)
* Sail with your ship and [[Docking point|dock]] at the island (requires 87 Sailing)
* [[Teleport to Boat|Teleport to your boat]] (if it's situated at Grimstone, which requires completion of [[Pandemonium]], 67 [[Magic]], and a [[Greater teleport focus (facility)|greater teleport focus]] on the boat)
